ThingDef.label: trading depot
ThingDef.description: Trading depots need to be placed near the settlement heart and can be used to continuously sell or buy goods.

ThingDef.label: warehouse pillar
ThingDef.description: A central coordination point for organizing labor and inventory. It establishes a 'standard of order' within its adjustable range, significantly increasing move speed. \n\nHowever, the strict focus on efficiency makes the area unsuitable for rest or intellectual thought.

ThingDef.label: production pillar
ThingDef.description: Marks the heart of the settlements production facilities. Improves work facilities, but also worsens living conditions nearby. Can only be built once per map and has a adjustable effect radius.

ThingDef.label: laboratory pillar
ThingDef.description: Coordinates high-level research. The "Mindful" environment boosts discovery but discourages consumerism and speed.

ThingDef.label: hospital pillar
ThingDef.description: Establishes a sterile sanctum. The "Clean" property aids recovery but is too cautious for industrial production.

ThingDef.label: bastion pillar
ThingDef.description: A tactical coordination post. The "Agitating" environment keeps soldiers alert but makes long-term living stressful.

ThingDef.label: prison pillar
ThingDef.description: tbd

ThingDef.label: party hall pillar
ThingDef.description: tbd

ThingDef.label: generator pillar
ThingDef.description: A massive industrial monolith that acts as a central capacitor and governor for the settlement's power grid. It overclocks all nearby power-generating structures, significantly increasing their watt output while streamlining the consumption of connected machinery. \n\nEstablishes a 'High-Voltage' zone. Detrimental to sleep, diplomacy, and medical care. Only suitable for heavy industry and power plants.

ThingDef.label: townhall pillar
ThingDef.description: A majestic monument to civic order and political authority. It establishes a 'Bureaucratic Hub' that significantly enhances trade, diplomacy, and the social standing of the settlement's leaders. \n\nEstablishes an environment where words carry weight, but hands go idle. Absolutely unsuitable for the grit of the forge or the sterile quiet of a laboratory.

ThingDef.label: meditation pillar
ThingDef.description: A towering monolith that anchors the settlement's spirits. It establishes a 'Vortex of Stillness' that empowers meditation, royal dignity, and peaceful rest. \n\nHowever, the absolute silence and psychic pressure here make it impossible to conduct frantic industrial labor or rigorous scientific research.

ThingDef.label: kitchen marker
ThingDef.description: A brass floor-sigil marking a sector of professional culinary production. By establishing a 'Standard of Catering' within its radius, it provides comfort and nutritional efficiency to nearby residents and diners. \n\nBeneficial when placed adjacent to large apartment complexes or grand dining halls.

ThingDef.label: science cabinet
ThingDef.description: A storage for precise instruments. When placed in a Laboratory, it provides a "Mindful" bonus to nearby medical facilities.

ThingDef.label: electrical cabinet marker
ThingDef.description: A brass floor-sigil marking a localized power distribution junction. By stabilizing the current and optimizing transformer output within its radius, it significantly reduces the energy drain of industrial machinery and lighting. \n\nEssential for high-tech workshops and energy-heavy production zones.

ThingDef.label: sanitation hub marker
ThingDef.description: A specialized floor-sigil that coordinates local plumbing and waste management. It ensures that toilets, showers, and basins within its radius operate at peak efficiency by establishing a 'Standard of Sanitation'. \n\nRequires an established bathroom to function.

ThingDef.label: breakroom marker
ThingDef.description: A designated floor-sigil for a respite area. It provides a subtle focus-enhancing atmosphere for the sector. \n\nSynergizes with almost all labor types by optimizing machine throughput and providing a mental safety net for workers.

ThingDef.label: doctor's office marker
ThingDef.description: A dedicated administrative and diagnostic hub for the settlement's medical staff. By centralizing medical records and diagnostic tools, it allows doctors to work with increased speed and surgical precision. \n\nCrucial for high-risk operations and crisis management.

ThingDef.label: greenery marker
ThingDef.description: A brass floor-sigil marking a sector of cultivated life. By optimizing the local micro-climate and soil-energy flow, it enhances plant growth and provides a soothing atmosphere for those working with organic materials. \n\nCrucial for high-yield hydroponics and serene meditation halls.

ThingDef.label: settlement center
ThingDef.description: The centerpiece monument to represent the glorious achievements of your settlement.

ThingDef.label: settlement office table
ThingDef.description: A table that allows organizing the daily troubles of larger settlements to achieve a fast-working community.

ThingDef.label: gardener bench
ThingDef.description: A table that allows preparing gardening duties.

ThingDef.label: wardening spot
ThingDef.description: A spot for standing guard at. Standing guard here improves the settlement buffer.

ThingDef.label: Monument of People Construction Site
ThingDef.description: A place for the people to construct their monument. Will be contructed by the people in their recreation time.

ThingDef.label: Monument of People
ThingDef.description: A monument displaying how far the people of this settlement have already come.

ThingDef.label: commodity
ThingDef.description: Traders as colonists alike love to get commodities. They are willing to find silver in the deepest hidden pockets to emburse you for them.
